content.title: STAAR Surgical reveals board dissent over amended Alcon deal ahead of vote
content.summary: Investing.com -- STAAR Surgical Company (NASDAQ:STAA) disclosed new details about board deliberations surrounding its amended $28-per-share sale to Alcon AG (NYSE:ALC), revealing on Monday that the board is no longer unanimous in its support for the revised terms and that CEO Stephen Farrell was unable to secure a price increase before directors voted to proceed.

content.title: Broadwood continues pressure on STAAR board, urges new directors amid go-shop move
